description: Full build of the internal physical therapy business app — Kotlin backend (Javalin + PostgreSQL) through Android, iOS, and Windows Desktop clients (Kotlin Multiplatform + Compose Multiplatform).

userStories.title: CapabilityService.hasCapability + JWT deny list
userStories.description: As the backend, I need a central capability check method and an in-memory deny list so that all auth checks go through one path and inactive users are immediately blocked.
acceptanceCriteria: CapabilityService.hasCapability(userId, capabilityCode, contextType, contextId): Boolean queries the active_user_capabilities view
Returns true if any matching row exists, false otherwise
JWT middleware checks deny list (ConcurrentHashMap<UUID, Instant>) before the capability query; deny-listed users receive 401
On server startup, deny list is populated from app_user WHERE status = 'INACTIVE'
Deny list entries are evicted after 24 hours (JWT max lifetime)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: active_user_capabilities view already exists in V1__full_schema.sql. contextType maps to capability_context_type enum.

userStories.title: BranchDayService — resolveOrCreate and assertEditable
userStories.description: As the backend, I need a shared service to resolve or create a branch_day row and assert it is editable so that every other module can call it before any write.
acceptanceCriteria: BranchDayService.resolveOrCreate(branchId: UUID, date: LocalDate): BranchDay — UPSERT branch_day (branch_id, date) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, returns the row
BranchDayService.assertEditable(branchDayId: UUID, userId: UUID) — evaluates effective status lazily: if branch_day.date < today (Asia/Manila) and status=OPEN, treat as PAST
If effective status is PAST or REMITTED, checks caller holds EDIT_PAST_DAY capability for the branch; throws 403 if not
If effective status is REMITTED and a write is attempted, the caller must supply a non-null reason; service throws 400 if absent
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: 4AM Manila boundary: branchDate.plusDays(1).atTime(4,0).atZone(ZoneId.of('Asia/Manila')). Called by every service before any financial or operational write.

userStories.title: User deactivation endpoint
userStories.description: As an Owner or Manager, I want to deactivate a user so that they immediately lose all access.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH /users/{userId}/deactivate sets app_user.status = INACTIVE
Requires MANAGE_USERS capability with GLOBAL context
On deactivation, userId is added to the in-memory deny list
Subsequent requests from that user return 401
Audit log entry written for the UPDATE (table=app_user, action=UPDATE)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Branch CRUD endpoints
userStories.description: As an Owner or Manager, I want to create and list branches so that the system knows which locations exist.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /branches body: { id (UUID, client-generated), name, branchType } — idempotency via id as PK; requires MANAGE_USERS capability
GET /branches — returns all branches; any authenticated user
GET /branches/{branchId} — returns single branch

userStories.title: User branch assignment and slot endpoints
userStories.description: As an Owner or Manager, I want to assign users to home branches and set their slot so that the system knows who belongs where.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /branches/{branchId}/assignments body: { userId, slot } — INSERT user_branch_assignment with ended_at=NULL; requires MANAGE_USERS; enforced by idx_one_active_assignment partial unique index
DELETE /branches/{branchId}/assignments/{userId} — sets ended_at=now() on the active assignment
PATCH /branches/{branchId}/assignments/{userId}/slot body: { slot } — updates slot; requires caller to be the assigned user OR hold MANAGE_USERS
POST /branches/{branchId}/slots/swap body: { userIdA, userIdB } — swaps slot numbers for both users in one transaction
Audit log entry written for each UPDATE/INSERT
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Clock-in endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to clock into a branch so that my attendance is recorded and I can access that branch's data.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /attendance/clock-in body: { attendanceId (UUID), branchId } — idempotency via attendanceId as PK

Service calls resolveOrCreate(branchId, today), then UPSERT branch_day_assignment (computing is_relief by checking user_branch_assignment for active home assignment), then INSERT attendance with clock_in=now()
is_relief = true if no active user_branch_assignment exists for this user+branch
Returns existing row as 200 on duplicate attendanceId (idempotency)
Triggers commission recalculation for the branch_day
Audit log entry written
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: idx_one_active_clock_in partial unique index (user_id, branch_day_id WHERE clock_out IS NULL) prevents double clock-in.

userStories.title: Clock-out endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to clock out so that my attendance window is closed.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /attendance/clock-out body: { attendanceId } — UPDATE attendance SET clock_out=now() WHERE id=attendanceId AND clock_out IS NULL
Idempotent: if clock_out already set, return existing row as 200
Triggers commission recalculation for the branch_day
Audit log entry written
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Relief access request endpoint
userStories.description: As a relief user, I want to request edit access from a checked-in user so that I can make changes at the branch.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /relief-access/request body: { requestId (UUID), branchDayId, targetUserId } — INSERT grant_relief_access with status=PENDING; idempotency via requestId as PK
Target user must have an open clock-in (clock_out IS NULL) for the branch_day; reject 400 otherwise
Requesting user must have is_relief=true in branch_day_assignment for this branch_day; reject 403 otherwise
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Relief access grant/deny endpoint
userStories.description: As a checked-in user, I want to grant or deny a relief access request so that the relief user can or cannot edit.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH /relief-access/{requestId}/grant — UPDATE grant_relief_access SET status=GRANTED, granted_by=caller, granted_at=now(); INSERT user_capability (source_type=RELIEF_ACCESS, context_type=BRANCH_DAY, context_id=branch_day.id, valid_to=4AM Manila next day in UTC, priority=10); both in one transaction
If idx_one_grant_per_day unique constraint fires (GRANTED row already exists for same requested_by+branch_day_id), silently return 200
PATCH /relief-access/{requestId}/deny — UPDATE status=DENIED

userStories.title: Medical mission delegate assign/revoke

userStories.title: Client create and search endpoints

POST /clients body: { id (UUID), firstName, lastName, middleName?, suffix?, phoneNumber?, address, gender, age, systolicBp?, diastolicBp?, medicalConditions? } — idempotency via id as PK
GET /clients?q= — fuzzy name search via pg_trgm ILIKE '%q%' on (first_name || ' ' || last_name); also exact phone prefix match; returns id, fullName, phone, age, gender
GET /clients/{clientId} — full client record

userStories.title: Session create endpoint
userStories.description: As a practitioner, I want to create a session for a client so that the visit is recorded with the correct type and price.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /sessions body: { id (UUID), clientId, branchId, isWalkIn, requestedPractitionerId?, finalPrice, remarks?, otherConcerns?, bookedAt?, nextAppointmentDate? } — idempotency via id as PK
Service acquires SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on client row to prevent concurrent session race
Checks no active PENDING session exists for this client (idx_client_one_pending_session); returns 409 if one exists
Calls resolveOrCreate for branch+today

Computes session_type using the standard algorithm (MEDICAL_MISSION branch → MEDICAL_MISSION; PROVINCIAL_TOUR + 0 prior → PROVINCIAL_FIRST; 0 prior → REGULAR; 1 prior → SECOND_SESSION; else SUBSEQUENT); prior count uses active_session_voids view to exclude voided sessions and excludes MEDICAL_MISSION type sessions
Snapshots base_price from the current active session_base_rate for branch+session_type
Requires EDIT_BRANCH_DATA capability for the branch
Audit log entry written
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Session status update endpoint

Walk-in sessions reject NO_SHOW and CANCELLED (walk_in_status constraint enforced at DB and service layer)

Typecheck passes

PATCH /sessions/{sessionId}/practitioners/{practitionerId} body: { remarks } — update remarks; requires EDIT_BRANCH_DATA

userStories.title: Product category and product CRUD
userStories.description: As a coordinator or owner, I want to create and manage product categories and products so that inventory can be tracked.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /product-categories body: { id (UUID), name } — requires MANAGE_PRODUCTS; idempotency via id
GET /product-categories — list all
POST /products body: { id (UUID), name, productCategoryId, unitPrice, commissionAmount } — requires MANAGE_PRODUCTS; idempotency via id
PATCH /products/{productId} body: { name?, unitPrice?, commissionAmount?, isActive? } — requires MANAGE_PRODUCTS
GET /products — list all products where is_active=true, with category name

userStories.title: Branch inventory management and restock
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I want to add products to a branch and restock so that inventory levels are tracked.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /branches/{branchId}/inventory body: { productId } — INSERT branch_inventory (current_stock=0) if not exists ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; requires MANAGE_PRODUCTS

POST /branches/{branchId}/inventory/{productId}/restock body: { movementId (UUID), quantity, branchDayId } — requires MANAGE_PRODUCTS; calls assertEditable; INSERT inventory_movement (reason=RESTOCK, quantity_change=+quantity, moved_by=caller); UPDATE branch_inventory SET current_stock=current_stock+quantity, version=version+1 WHERE version=expectedVersion; returns 409 on version mismatch; idempotency via movementId
GET /branches/{branchId}/inventory — list all branch_inventory rows for the branch with product name, category, current_stock
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Product sale endpoint
userStories.description: As a practitioner, I want to record a product sale so that stock decreases and commission is recalculated.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /product-sales body: { id (UUID), branchDayId, sessionId?, clientId?, isWalkIn, productId, quantity, expectedVersion } — idempotency via id as PK
Service calls assertEditable; snapshots unit_price_at_time and commission_amount_at_time from product table; computes total_amount_at_time = unit_price_at_time * quantity

SELECT FOR UPDATE on branch_inventory; if current_stock - quantity < 0 throw 400 (insufficient stock); UPDATE branch_inventory with optimistic lock (expectedVersion); INSERT inventory_movement (reason=SALE, quantity_change=-quantity); INSERT product_sale — all in one transaction

sale_type_logic constraint: (session sale: sessionId NOT NULL, clientId NULL, isWalkIn=false) OR (known walk-in: sessionId NULL, clientId NOT NULL, isWalkIn=true) OR (anonymous: sessionId NULL, clientId NULL, isWalkIn=true)
Triggers commission recalculation for the branch_day after transaction commits
Audit log entry written
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: commission_amount_at_time stored as NUMERIC(15,4). All commission arithmetic uses BigDecimal.

userStories.title: Non-sale inventory movement endpoint
userStories.description: As a practitioner, I want to record tester, sample, missing, and adjustment movements so that stock levels stay accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /branches/{branchId}/inventory/{productId}/movement body: { movementId (UUID), reason, quantityChange, notes?, branchDayId, expectedVersion } — idempotency via movementId
Calls assertEditable; validates sign per reason at service layer (RESTOCK>0, SALE/TESTER/SAMPLE/MISSING<0, ADJUSTMENT either); MISSING requires non-empty notes
UPDATE branch_inventory current_stock with optimistic lock; INSERT inventory_movement; returns 409 on version mismatch
Audit log entry written
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: DB constraints (quantity_sign, missing_notes) act as final safety net. Service validates first.

userStories.title: Compensation assign endpoint
userStories.description: As a coordinator or owner, I want to assign daily compensation to each user so that they know what they're owed.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /compensation body: { id (UUID), workBranchDayId, payingBranchDayId, userId, amount, note? } — requires ASSIGN_COMPENSATION; idempotency via id as PK; idx_compensation_unique (user_id, paying_branch_day_id) prevents duplicate payout
PATCH /compensation/{compensationId} body: { amount?, note? } — update; last-write-wins (no version check required)

userStories.title: Commission manual inclusion/exclusion and split read endpoint
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I want to manually include or exclude a user from a product sale's commission and view the daily split so that errors can be corrected.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /commission-inclusions body: { id (UUID), productSaleId, userId, isIncluded, reason? } — UPSERT on (productSaleId, userId) unique constraint; triggers full commission recalculation for the affected branch_day after transaction commits
GET /commission-splits/{branchDayId} — returns commission_split rows for the branch_day with user display names and amounts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Commission recalculation algorithm: fetch all product_sales for branch_day; for each sale find attendance-eligible users; apply manual inclusions/exclusions; split commission_amount_at_time*quantity equally (BigDecimal); batch UPSERT commission_split; DELETE dropped users.

userStories.title: Allowance assign endpoint

userStories.title: Remittance draft create endpoint
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I want to create a remittance draft covering a date range so that I can prepare before submitting.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /remittances body: { id (UUID), type (SESSION|PRODUCT), branchId, method (BANK_TRANSFER|HANDED_TO_ACCOUNTANT), dateRangeStart, dateRangeEnd } — requires SUBMIT_REMITTANCE; idempotency via id as PK; INSERT remittance with status=DRAFT, submitted_date=today (Manila)

userStories.title: Remittance line and day breakdown management
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I want to add and remove sessions or product sales from a remittance draft and link branch days so that the right items are covered.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /remittances/{remittanceId}/lines body: { id (UUID), type, sessionId?, productSaleId?, amount } — amount is snapshot at time of inclusion; idempotency via id; INSERT remittance_line; optimistic lock on remittance.version
DELETE /remittances/{remittanceId}/lines/{lineId} — soft delete: SET deleted_by=caller, deleted_at=now(); optimistic lock on remittance.version
POST /remittances/{remittanceId}/day-breakdowns body: { branchDayId } — INSERT remittance_day_breakdown; unique (remittance_id, branch_day_id)
GET /remittances/{remittanceId} — returns remittance with all non-deleted lines and day breakdowns
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: line_type_logic constraint: SESSION line requires sessionId NOT NULL and productSaleId NULL; PRODUCT_SALE line requires productSaleId NOT NULL and sessionId NULL.

userStories.title: Remittance submission endpoint
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I want to submit a remittance so that it is finalized, snapshotted, and covered branch days are marked REMITTED.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /remittances/{remittanceId}/submit body: { expectedVersion } — requires SUBMIT_REMITTANCE
SERIALIZABLE transaction: SELECT FOR UPDATE on remittance; verify status=DRAFT and version=expectedVersion (409 on mismatch)
Calculate gross_income = SUM(remittance_line.amount WHERE type=SESSION AND deleted_at IS NULL)
Calculate total_compensation = SUM(compensation.amount) for paying_branch_day_ids in remittance_day_breakdown
Calculate total_expenses = SUM(expense.amount WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) for branch_days in remittance_day_breakdown
INSERT remittance_financial_snapshot (immutable trigger in DB blocks future UPDATE/DELETE) — SESSION remittances only; PRODUCT remittances skip this step
UPDATE remittance SET status=SUBMITTED, version=version+1
UPDATE branch_day SET status=REMITTED for all branch_days in remittance_day_breakdown (idempotent — already REMITTED rows are fine)
Audit log entries written for remittance UPDATE and each branch_day UPDATE
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: fn_remittance_snapshot_immutable trigger already exists in V1__full_schema.sql.

userStories.title: Notification table migration and next appointment alert scheduler
userStories.description: As the backend, I need a notification table and a daily scheduler that alerts coordinators of upcoming appointments.
acceptanceCriteria: New Flyway migration creates notification table: (id UUID PK, user_id UUID → app_user, session_id UUID → session, message TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), read_at TIMESTAMPTZ)
Scheduler runs once daily at 07:00 Asia/Manila
Query: sessions WHERE next_appointment_date = CURRENT_DATE + 2 days AND session_status = 'COMPLETED' AND id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM active_session_voids)

For each matched session, INSERT one notification per Coordinator assigned to that branch (find via user_branch_assignment WHERE ended_at IS NULL and the user holds SUBMIT_REMITTANCE or VOID_SESSION capability for that branch)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Scheduler lives in backend/scheduler/. Delegates to a NotificationService — no business logic in the scheduler itself.

userStories.title: Shared HTTP client and token store (commonMain)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a shared Ktor HTTP client in commonMain that attaches the JWT to every request and handles retry so that all platforms share one networking layer.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Ktor client dependencies to shared module: ktor-client-core, ktor-client-content-negotiation, ktor-serialization-kotlinx-json; platform engines: OkHttp (Android), Darwin (iOS), CIO (Desktop/JVM)

On network timeout, retries up to 3 times with the same request (safe due to client-generated UUID idempotency keys)
AuthTokenStore expect/actual: Android = EncryptedSharedPreferences, iOS = Keychain wrapper, Desktop = file in user app data dir

Each ViewModel exposes a StateFlow<UiState> and suspend event methods
ViewModels use the shared ApiClient; zero platform-specific code inside them
UiState data classes are defined in commonMain alongside the ViewModels

userStories.title: Android app — login screen
userStories.description: As a user, I want to log in on Android so that I can access the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Compose login screen with username field, password field (hidden), and login button
On submit: calls AuthViewModel.login(); shows loading indicator while in flight
